Protection_Need: Only the owner and currently authorized collaborators may retrieve each evidence object.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: For every list/download route, server-side authorization shall evaluate the signed-in principal against that specific evidence ID and current share grants.
Acceptance_Criteria: Two users: owner and grantee succeed; a third authenticated user and anonymous request receive 403 or non-disclosing 404; enumeration exposes no file content.
Planned_Verification: Authorization integration test with 3 accounts + negative HTTP evidence

Protection_Need: Only the evidence owner may grant access to a named existing user.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Share endpoint shall require owner permission and a validated target account; reject self/invalid grants without exposing evidence.
Acceptance_Criteria: Authorized grant succeeds; non-owner and unknown target cannot create grants; database remains unchanged on rejected attempts.

Protection_Need: Revoked collaborators must lose access at the next request.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Revocation shall update server-side grant state and every later download shall recheck current permissions.
Acceptance_Criteria: After revocation, previously authorized collaborator receives 403/404; owner still succeeds.
Planned_Verification: Grant → download → revoke → denied regression test

Protection_Need: Non-owners must not delete or alter evidence objects.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Delete operation shall be owner-only; denied attempts shall not remove metadata, grants, or bytes.
Acceptance_Criteria: Unauthorized delete rejected and original owner can still download the same file and digest.

Protection_Need: Sensitive operations must require an authenticated user.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Upload, list, download, share, revoke, delete and audit views shall enforce authenticated session checks.
Acceptance_Criteria: Each protected endpoint rejects unauthenticated requests; authenticated owner workflows succeed.

Protection_Need: Passwords must not be exposed in source, logs or stored as plaintext.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Use vetted salted password hashing; never persist plaintext; prevent secrets from being printed.
Acceptance_Criteria: Database password hash differs from entered password, login verifies it, no source code contains seeded plaintext credentials.

Protection_Need: User sessions must resist predictable or cross-site misuse.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Use signed/unpredictable session state, HttpOnly and SameSite cookies, logout invalidation and appropriate expiry; Secure flag under HTTPS.
Acceptance_Criteria: Logout prevents reuse; cookie attributes are visible; altered tokens are rejected.
Planned_Verification: Cookie/header inspection and session lifecycle tests

Protection_Need: Cross-site pages must not silently perform sensitive state changes.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: All authenticated browser state-changing forms shall require session-bound anti-CSRF token verification plus SameSite cookies.
Acceptance_Criteria: Missing/wrong token rejected (403); correct token accepted; GET has no state-changing side effect.
Planned_Verification: CSRF negative/positive test and controlled forged-form demo

Protection_Need: Sensitive pages must not be operable when embedded by an untrusted site.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Authenticated pages shall emit CSP frame-ancestors 'none' and X-Frame-Options DENY.
Acceptance_Criteria: Browser refuses to render secure page within cross-origin iframe; secure response headers contain the policy.
Planned_Verification: Browser iframe demo + response header test

Protection_Need: Evidence files must not be publicly available through static web paths.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Store evidence outside static root; access only via authorized server download route.
Acceptance_Criteria: A guessed direct path cannot retrieve bytes; authorized API download succeeds.
Planned_Verification: HTTP direct-path negative test + storage inspection

Protection_Need: External identifiers must not reveal paths or grant access by themselves.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Generate opaque evidence IDs and server-controlled storage names; never use client filenames as filesystem path components.
Acceptance_Criteria: Uploads receive non-sequential random-looking IDs; path-like filenames do not traverse storage.
Planned_Verification: Upload metadata and path traversal tests

Protection_Need: Large uploads must not exhaust service capacity.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Reject oversized uploads with a configured maximum and bounded streaming/storage; clean up failed writes.
Acceptance_Criteria: Configured over-limit upload rejected, not written to disk; subsequent normal request still succeeds.
Planned_Verification: Boundary-size integration test and disk inspection

Protection_Need: Untrusted metadata must not corrupt native memory.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Bound and validate native helper input lengths; use bounded memory operations; compile and test helper with AddressSanitizer.
Acceptance_Criteria: Overlong input terminates safely with non-zero validation error; ASAN reports no overflow for fixed parser.
Planned_Verification: Controlled legacy/fixed C harness + ASAN output

Protection_Need: User-supplied values must not become shell commands.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Invoke the fixed native helper through argument arrays with shell disabled; validate input and set timeout.
Acceptance_Criteria: Shell metacharacter input is treated as data or rejected; marker file/extra command never executes in secure version.

Protection_Need: Untrusted filenames and paths must not escape private storage.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Normalize and validate display metadata; use server-generated object storage paths, never client-supplied path segments.
Acceptance_Criteria: Traversal patterns do not create or read files outside the configured private store.

Protection_Need: Evidence bytes must have a verifiable integrity reference.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Compute SHA-256 on upload, store digest, and recompute/compare before authorized download or verification.
Acceptance_Criteria: Original bytes match the stored digest; a deliberately modified test file is flagged as mismatched.

Protection_Need: Security-relevant evidence actions must be accountable.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Record actor, event, evidence ID, outcome and UTC timestamp for upload/share/revoke/download/delete/failed authorization without recording file contents.
Acceptance_Criteria: Each required event generates a timestamped record tied to actor and object; failures are recorded without file bytes.
Planned_Verification: Audit event integration test and record screenshot

Protection_Need: Audit and error messages must not disclose secrets or evidence contents.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Do not log passwords, session tokens, full file bodies, or secret configuration; use generic client errors.
Acceptance_Criteria: Known secret/test content strings are absent from generated audit/error logs; 500 response does not show stack trace.

Protection_Need: Database requests must not permit SQL manipulation by user inputs.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Use parameterized DB operations and validated input; avoid dynamic SQL composition from request values.
Acceptance_Criteria: SQL metacharacter username/filename does not change query scope, corrupt data, or authenticate falsely.
Planned_Verification: DB query tests / static code review

Protection_Need: Invalid file metadata must fail closed without crashing normal workflows.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Validate length, encoding and allowed metadata at the web/native boundary; apply subprocess timeout and nonzero error handling.
Acceptance_Criteria: Empty/overlong/invalid input rejected with controlled HTTP error; health endpoint stays reachable.

Protection_Need: Deployment and build secrets must remain private and separately configurable.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Read secrets from environment/secret store; ignore .env and avoid real tokens in repo, images, CI logs and screenshots.
Acceptance_Criteria: Repository secret scan has no real secret; app refuses unsafe missing production secret; local .env is ignored.

Protection_Need: High/critical findings must block the secure delivery workflow.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Run tests, SAST and DAST evidence workflow; enforce a nonzero security stage result for verified high/critical findings.
Acceptance_Criteria: Passing clean run is green; synthetic/known high finding in a controlled test makes required CI check fail.
Planned_Verification: GitHub Actions/SAST/DAST artifacts, passing and failing screenshots

Protection_Need: Security changes must be reviewed and traceable to the need they address.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Protect main; merge via PR with one peer approval; name PNE-ID in issue/PR and link later threat, fix, test records.
Acceptance_Criteria: Main denies direct push; sample PR has reviewer approval and linked issue/test; actual issue keys saved after creation.
Planned_Verification: GitHub settings screenshot + real PR screenshot

Protection_Need: Service failures must be detectable and startup reproducible.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Provide health endpoint, repeatable Docker Compose configuration, and clear restart/run instructions.
Acceptance_Criteria: Container starts from documented commands and /health responds; restart returns service to healthy state.

Protection_Need: Application runtime should minimize privileges.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Run container process as non-root with least required filesystem permissions and avoid privileged mounting.
Acceptance_Criteria: Inspection shows non-root UID and private writable directory only where required.

Protection_Need: Remote deployment should protect session and evidence traffic in transit.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: For any internet-facing environment, terminate TLS and set Secure cookies; local HTTP is lab-only and must not be called production-ready.
Acceptance_Criteria: HTTPS request succeeds; HTTP redirects/rejected and browser cookie carries Secure in deployed environment.

Protection_Need: Evidence and configuration should be recoverable after storage failures.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Define encrypted backup, restore and integrity-check procedure for DB and file store; test before production use.
Acceptance_Criteria: Restored dummy evidence metadata and bytes match recorded digest after a rehearsal.

Protection_Need: Authentication attempts should be resistant to automated guessing.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Introduce per-account/IP login throttling and monitored failure events before broader exposure.
Acceptance_Criteria: Repeated failed attempts trigger bounded rejection without blocking unrelated accounts.

Protection_Need: Evidence retention and deletion must follow an explicit policy.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: Agree retention limits and deletion semantics; prevent unauthorized purge and document backups not necessarily erased by live deletion.
Acceptance_Criteria: Policy defines retention and delete effect on primary/backup copy; sample deletion verified.

Protection_Need: Audit records should become tamper-evident for real investigations.
Measurable_Security_Requirement: For production, forward audit logs to protected append-only/tamper-evident store; a mutable local SQLite audit table is not tamper-proof.
Acceptance_Criteria: Attempted modification detectable via protected archive/integrity chain; evidence of independent storage.
